field.label: Satellite tracking
field.help: Show the satellites overhead. When enabled, this firewall downloads public Starlink orbit data from celestrak.org, at most a few times a day. Off by default.

field.label: Latitude
field.help: Decimal degrees, south is negative, for example -41.29. About two decimals is plenty. Stored only in this firewall's configuration.

field.label: Longitude
field.help: Decimal degrees, west is negative, for example 174.78.
